description: Generate the bracket for a tournament (organizer step 3, after the roster is in; needs manage_code). SINGLE-ELIMINATION ONLY in this version — tournaments of other formats return an error. PREVIEW FIRST: call without confirm_preview_id to get a preview_id and bracket preview — nothing is written. Show the preview to the user, then call again with {tournament_id, code, confirm_preview_id} to commit. The roster is the tournament's own player list (the same one the player page shows), paired by the same seeding the pages use; match ids are the pages' sequential labels M1, M2, ... A players list may be given to override the roster for the preview.

confirm_preview_id.description: preview_id from the preview call — pass only to commit that exact preview

players.description: Optional list of player names to preview with instead of the current roster

name: generate_bracket
